note: Two complete exports (the simulator's Export JSON with a custom APL chosen) that Preston A. Elder produced on wowsims.com on 2026-10-26 and gave to this project. They are user-provided exports, not files copied from a repository: the rotation in each is a WowSims preset the sim offered, the rest is the person's own character settings (name, gear, buffs). Used as real input for the converter's golden tests.

classic-era-shaman-ele.export.json.note: Classic Era, Elemental Shaman, the simulator's default rotation as an APL

forever-shaman-ele.export.json.spec: enhancement (the settings carry an enhancementShaman block)
forever-shaman-ele.export.json.note: WoW Forever, a Shaman APL with prepull actions, totemRemainingTime, mana percent and a resource potion
